title: 阳光下的行李牌  (Sunlight on the Tag)

segments.t: At midday, Chen opens the hallway storeroom to air it out after the rain and sets the unclaimed blue suitcase beside the desk right as Teacher Song walks in. Listen first.
我打扫储藏室，把这个蓝色行李箱在这儿放五分钟。
轻拿轻放啊，老陈——明天中午就是星期五了！
呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角上还刻着两个小时候的缩写！
宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
老木匠……还有箱子里的木头小火车！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
轻拿轻放啊，老陈——明天中午就是星期五了！
'Handle it gently, Chen—tomorrow at noon is Friday!' Delivery box favourite:
轻拿轻放
literally 'lightly pick up, lightly set down', means 'handle with care'.
呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
'Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?' Vivid metaphor:
双胞胎
means 'twins', playful shorthand for two identical dark-blue suitcases.
您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
'Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.' Warm permission word:
尽管
tells someone 'feel completely free to go ahead without holding back'.
等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角上还刻着两个小时候的缩写！
'Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials carved on the corner!' Chinese addresses march from bigger street down to house number: 'Wutong Lane twelve number'.
何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
'More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!' Rhetorical booster
何止
asks 'how could it stop at merely...?'—'far more than just know it!'.
二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
'Twenty-five years ago? Right inside that very same house?' Entire buildings and houses take
栋
originally the main ridgepole timber holding up a roof.
那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
'An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!' Notice how
弹
means 'pluck or press with fingers', the action word used for playing piano or guitar.
老木匠……还有箱子里的木头小火车！
'An old carpenter... and the wooden toy train inside the bag!' Skilled word:
木匠
pairs 'wood' with 'master artisan' for carpenter. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
我打扫储藏室，把这个蓝色行李箱在这儿放五分钟。
轻拿轻放啊，老陈——明天中午就是星期五了！
呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角上还刻着两个小时候的缩写！
宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
老木匠……还有箱子里的木头小火车！
Bright sunlight on an old paper tag just unlocked twenty-five years of history: two brothers on Wutong Lane and their grandfather's wooden train. One scene left in Episode 4—see you next time.
